scope: Research report self-review; no new hypothesis or direction supplied to editors.

contribution.evidence: Generic patch interface, matched text catalogue and exact candidate/snapshot evidence; no novel recommendation algorithm claimed.

clarity.evidence: Dataset, prompt, model, compiler, selection, per-seed results and costs preserved.

empirical_strength.evidence: Two independent editor replicates; mixed results across conditions and below EASE contextual reference. No claim of general improvement or superiority.

evaluation.evidence: One filtered MovieLens cohort; full-catalogue metrics, groups and duplicate-text diagnostic. Controls not fully matched in search space or adaptive behavior.

method.evidence: No fitting or forward scoring by editors. Changes bounded to 50% global relative L2. Instruction allowlists are not OS isolation; generic invalid feedback may affect blind candidate feasibility.
